def transform(g):
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    sep = 2
    row_cuts = [i for i in range(h) if all(x == sep for x in g[i])]
    col_cuts = [j for j in range(w) if all(g[i][j] == sep for i in range(h))]
    def spans(n, cuts):
        result, start = [], 0
        for cut in cuts + [n]:
            if cut > start:
                result.append((start, cut))
            start = cut + 1
        return result
    rows, cols = spans(h, row_cuts), spans(w, col_cuts)
    colors = {v for row in g for v in row if v != sep}
    bg = max(colors, key=lambda c: sum(v == c for row in g for v in row))
    mark = next(c for c in colors if c != bg)
    return [[1 if sum(g[i][j] == mark for i in range(a, b) for j in range(c, d)) >= 2 else bg
             for c, d in cols] for a, b in rows]
